angle: Place-based: state/regional economic-development announcements 2023-2026 (governor/commerce/EDC releases and trade-press re-reports), local business news on each announced plant, plus one directory-style query; no OSHA, no NAICS lists, no EPA discovery, no welder postings.
searches_until_dry: not reached: cap of ~30 discovery searches hit while searches 25-30 still produced new plants (MCG Harleysville/North Wales/West Chester, TxLa, JTS Abilene, Siemens Raleigh/Wendell, Siemens/Jabil VA, Intermountain Centralia, Baer Georgetown)
notes: in_definition rule: TRUE without 'boundary' flag = core product named on the page (e-house/PDC/modular electrical building, power skid/pod, prefab power module, modular data center, server rack/containment, outdoor electrical enclosure, mobile substation unit). TRUE with 'boundary' flag = switchgear/switchboard/PDU/RPP/cabinet makers, 'modular electrical assemblies', integration facilities, mobile-substation transformer makers; 'welding not stated' added unless the page states welding/fabrication. FALSE = explicit outs (generator enclosures, fuel tanks, BESS, bought-in enclosures, components, busway, lighting panels, warehouse/test sites), chiller makers with no stated welded frame/skid, and same-parent sites whose products are not stated. Counts (excluding 1 duplicate row): core in-definition 21 (plant_confirmed 18); boundary in-definition 35 (plant_confirmed 31); out/unclear 20. 19 in-definition rows are pre-production (announced/under construction or start date passed but status unverified). Quotes: each checked with tools/fetch_page.py --check; 70 of 77 pass live; 4 matched in the copy fetched today but live re-check was blocked by 403 (noted per row); 3 rows (AVL, GE Mebane, Integra Akron) rest on search summaries only, blank quote, quote_verified false. Coverage gaps: the state manufacturer-directory arm was effectively not run (one query, no directory searched); multi-state OR queries collapsed, so Florida, New Jersey, New York, New England, Maryland, Missouri, Michigan, Oklahoma, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Idaho, Colorado (beyond Crusoe) and the Dakotas/Mountain states got little or no real coverage; long-established plants with no 2023-26 announcement (legacy e-house/switchgear/rack shops) are a structural blind spot of this angle; Vertiv's 2026 'two additional' SC sites, Excellerate site products, TxLa and Vertiv PA cities are unresolved.
